Holdings_Audit.investment_thesis: Asia's largest crane renter is growing revenue 39% year on year with 86% fleet utilisation, a Rs 1,253 Cr order book and an A+ rated balance sheet, yet trades at about 14 times earnings, with the price implying only about 2.2% a year of profit growth. The risk is quality of growth: margin dilution, aging receivables, Saudi exposure and negative free cash flow. The 2.2% implied growth is profit-based and is not proof of a cash-based margin of safety.
Holdings_Audit.summary_rationale: WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT is the technical routing rule's label for a PASSED_CONDITIONAL name, applied to a holding because the taxonomy has no hold-and-wait label (KEEP_COMPOUNDING fails: Stage 2 not intact, gate only conditional). As a pipeline challenger the verdict is also WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT.

Holdings_Audit.invalidation_condition: Verified close below 4,350 (execution-conditional next-open sale); second Layer 2 KPI FAIL; any promoter pledge
Holdings_Audit.investment_thesis: Netweb is growing revenue and profit at very high rates (Q1 FY27 revenue +172%, PAT +180%) on AI-server demand, with a firm order book of Rs 2,507 crore plus Rs 848 crore L1. At Rs 4,592.90 the price assumes about 29% profit growth a year for ten years.
Holdings_Audit.summary_rationale: Hold, add none: Stage 3 pullback above a rising 200-DMA routes to WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT, but asymmetry is 0.32 (78.10 gain to base value / 242.90 loss to stop) vs 2.5 and 3Y CFO/PAT is 0.447, so gate PARTIAL. Rule 1: sell all 40 on a verified close below 4,350 (check official 23 Oct NSE close before Monday open); trim 20 at 6,742; Rule 4 upgrade test needs Stage 2 and 2.5:1 on the day (target 5,200 at 4,592.90, about 6,376 at 4,928.93). The 4,350 level is a next-open trigger, not a guaranteed price or loss cap.
